notes.title: OVERLOOP IS OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[h3]It's time for some dystopian fun with a cloning gun – Overloop has officially launched and is available to download right now![/h3]

The future is a total dumpster fire. Turns out creating a cloning gun and then selling it to the masses was a huge mistake. What loopy scientist could be so reckless and irresponsible as to invent such a dangerous device? Oh, that was YOU! Oopsies. 

Overloop is a short and sweet adventure set in a bleak-but-amusing apocalyptic world. Make clones of yoursef - up to four at once - and then sacrifice them with impunity to overcome deadly traps and puzzles. Succeed in your mission to overthrow the authoritarian regime of your former employer, Infinity Inc., to save humanity and - just maybe - redeem yourself. Get to it genius!

[previewyoutube=kfezwS8i_Z4;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] If you play Overloop and would like to leave some feedback, go ahead and drop it here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/720660/discussions/0/3314107199313563180/][b]Overloop Feedback[/b][/url]

[/list]
Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy Overloop!

notes.title: NEW DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]There's a new demo ready and waiting for you to download from the Store page![/b][/h1]

It's been updated in time for the latest Steam Festival, which is now underway and runs until next Thursday, 7 October, 10am PDT. 

The demo still consists of the intro and opening/tutorial level featured in the previous playable slice, and it's still all about making, using, and sacrificing clones, but it is significantly different thanks to a few key design and gameplay changes. 

Here are some of the main differences from the previous demo:

[list]
[*] The ability to double-jump has been removed
[*] The opening/tutorial level has been completely reworked
[*] The main character now wears a blue shirt, making him easier to identify as the 'original'
[*] There's now an AI friend called Dennis to help you (at least, he says he's your friend...)
[*] It's only possible to have one clone at a time for most of the demo
[*] Clone gun must now be upgraded in order to create multiple clones (instead of being dependent on how many clone 'charges' you have equipped)
[/list]
We hope you have fun playing the demo!

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: Overloop is a winner in the GWB Game Awards!
notes.notes:
Wooooo!!! Overloop has won a thing – it's been awarded silver at this year's GWB Game Awards! Huge congrats to the dev team (aka Charles and George) at Charge Games – it's well deserved recognition of what they're creating with Overloop.

The GWB stands for 'Games Without Borders' and the competition is an annual event to find [i]'upcoming games that shine above the rest. It's not about the size of the team or budget – it's about passion, quality and creativity'[/i]. The winning games were selected by a special panel of industry judges, which this year included Mark Brown from [b][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/MarkBrownGMT/featured]Game Maker's Toolkit[/url][/b].

Full list of [b][url=https://www.gamasutra.com/view/pressreleases/373796/The_Tencent_GWB_Game_Awards_2020.php]winners can be found on Gamasutra[/url][/b] (spoiler: Cloudpunk won the gold). 

Don't forget you can try Overloop RIGHT NOW thanks to the demo – just head on over to the game's store page and get that winner downloaded. And give it a wishlist while you're at it :)

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: Overloop Developer Steam Fest Stream
notes.notes:
[h1]ABOUT THIS GAME[/h1]
A year after Infinity Inc. put the cloning gun on the market, the world has fallen into chaos.
People started cloning everything: money, food, energy, and even themselves.
How many clones will you need to end Douglas Infinity's authoritarian regime? Can you save your own authenticity in a world where everything is a copy?

[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Clone yourself and sacrifice your clones to overcome deadly traps
[*] A thrilling dystopian story
[*] A journey through an apocalyptic world
[*] Deadly puzzles to solve
[/list]

notes.title: Overloop Update: Local Coop, New Art and Physics
notes.notes:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/DisfiguredShrillApe-size_restricted.gif[/img]

What's up everybody?

Last months i've been working hard on Overloop. Finally today i'm ready to share the progress with you. It's an exciting moment and i hope that you will enjoy what i want to show.

[h1]Improved visuals[/h1]

I liked an old Overloop's style, but i always felt like it's... too flat? It didn't have  enough lights/shadows, dimension, details. I spent freaking huge amount of time designing new visuals. What i see now is a big pleasure for my eyes. What do you think?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/d0059a986643b104dbe03b9e5d23912138633445.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/4504b635adeee5ac0db7de7ac1c38f97968fc337.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/1b03d1d42b88985bd72dc32c4cca1d7f2754fdcd.png[/img]

[h1]Local Coop[/h1]

Yes, there's a local coop and it works very well. One of my close friends said that Overloop plays 1000x times funnier with a friend. I'm going to agree with him. Unfortunately no multiplayer at this point, but let's see how local coop works first.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/NaiveAlienatedAmethystsunbird-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/CoolWhirlwindArchaeocete-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/f80d306b5e4ec5a925a5c3636f86886fc0f7420a.png[/img]

[h1]New physics[/h1]

I totally re-worked physics from scratch. Even twice. Finally i came up with a solutions similar to one used in Celeste by Matt Makes Games. It means that new physics is very stable and it's precision is pixel perfect. Also it allows you to build towers from clones, like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/dff34b934226f50975cb00dbab692ce6fd694d68.png[/img]

Well, other than that i fixed hundreds or even thouthsands important things to make Overloop as good as i can. 

Can't wait to show you the game and will do my best to make it soon in Beta 1. Are you still with me? Let me know your thoughts about all this.

P.S. Check out new screenshots in original resolution on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/720660/Overloop/]Overloop's Store Page[/url] 

George

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/827f4c17bbe97732fdaadaff37298a09dd9bc3f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Excellence in Game Design winner and $5000 for Overloop

Receiving an award for your game is always an inspiration - it works like a sign that you move in right direction.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31020872/575367651de794706e17ff3f35e0cae325b7cb2a.png[/img]
